overall_reason: The drafting-sheet concept (title block, FIG. numbers, crop marks, an exploded axonometric of the skill itself, a real before/after) is chosen for a diagram product and the copy is specific, but the surface is the current Claude-default editorial look: cream grid paper, Instrument Serif hero with a terracotta italic payoff word, and mono tracked caps on almost every label.

findings.evidence: Failed T-MIRROR: cream #faf9f6-style grid paper, Instrument Serif display, the italic terracotta (#bf4520) payoff "won't hate.", a three-cell mono caps spec strip ('DRAWING / EDITORIAL DIAGRAMS', 'RUNS ON / CLAUDE CODE · CODEX · PI', 'OUTPUT / HTML + INLINE SVG') and a terracotta square CTA. Any other agent-skill or dev-tool landing in 2026 gets this exact hero (sweep: warm-paper-serif and hairline-newspaper both cluster).
findings.before: Italic serif terracotta payoff word on cream with mono spec cells
findings.after: Keep the drafting concept but take its colour and type from technical drawing itself (e.g. a blueprint or pencil-on-vellum palette and a drafting sans), so the hero is the product's own aesthetic rather than the editorial default
findings.why: A recognisable look family chosen without a stated reason counts against 'made'; here the product even promises to remove 'rounded-box slop' while wearing the next default.

findings.evidence: Sweep counts 154 tracked caps labels and 198 mono labels: 'FIG. 00 · THE SKILL AT WORK', '17S · NO SOUND', 'FIG. 02A / FIRST PASS · NO SKILL', '45 TYPES · 6 AGENTS · 0 BUILD STEPS', section sub-lines like 'IT RUNS INSIDE THE AGENT YOU ALREADY USE. NOTHING NEW TO OPEN, NOTHING TO EXPORT.' set as caps mono.
findings.before: Every caption, sub-line and attribution in tracked mono caps
findings.after: Keep FIG. numbers where a figure is referenced; set the section sub-lines and the quote attribution in sentence-case body type
findings.why: Caps-mono chrome on everything is the hairline-newspaper tell; it also turns real sentences into decoration.

findings.evidence: Middot chains: "45 TYPES · 6 AGENTS · 0 BUILD STEPS", "CLAUDE CODE · CODEX · PI", "Open source · MIT", "5 LAYERS · 1 ACCENT" (sweep chrome_glyphs, 10 hits).
findings.after: Fold the one fact that matters into the sub-line (it already says '45 diagram types'); delete the chain
findings.why: Middot stat chains are template chrome and repeat facts stated a line above.

findings.evidence: Six equal feature blocks ('45 visual types', 'Brand-matched in ~60s', 'Self-contained HTML + SVG', 'Imports draw.io, Mermaid & Excalidraw', 'Optional accessible motion', 'Accessible by default') plus a three-up benefit row ('One accent, not six.', 'Real hierarchy.', 'Structure you can read.') in fragment-period style.
findings.before: "One accent, not six." / "Real hierarchy." / "Structure you can read."
findings.after: Annotate the before/after figure directly with these three points (callouts on FIG. 02B) and drop the separate three-up row
findings.why: Failed T-OVER-CORRECTION: the 'X, not Y.' fragment heads are the substitute habit of unslopped copy; the equal 6-grid is a stock section.

strengths: FIG. 01 draws the skill's own pipeline as an exploded axonometric with one accent layer: the product demonstrates itself in the hero.
A real before/after (FIG. 02A vs 02B) with honest alts describing both versions is proof, not a claim.
Copy is specific and only-this-product: 'No Figma. No rounded-box slop.', 'redraws (not converts)', install commands per host with real update instructions.
The 45-type gallery is numbered because readers do refer to types by number: numbering earns its place here.
not_investigated: Gallery thumbnails (01-45) render blank: images are loading=lazy and were not loaded at capture (complete=false, natural width 0). Not judged as design.
Demo video (demo-light.mp4) blocked in capture; FIG. 00 not judged.
Medium recorded as diagram, but the artifact is a landing page for a diagram tool; judged as web.
